component.subject: Call to Repentance
component.source: Revelation 3:17, 20, Open English Bible, release 2025.6 (US spelling), CC0, verbatim.

original.p: Revelation 3:17 (OEB 2025.6): You say ‘I am rich and have grown rich, and I want for nothing,’ and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, naked!
Revelation 3:20 (OEB 2025.6): I am standing at the door and knocking! If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will go in, and will feast with them, and they will feast with me.

block.p: You say ‘I am rich and have grown rich, and I want for nothing,’ and you do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, naked!
I am standing at the door and knocking! If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will go in, and will feast with them, and they will feast with me.
